Lily hopes to visit Xi'an one day. The weather was windy that day. Sam is interested in drawing. The broth simmers for six hours.
Lily borrowed a book about English from the supermarket. They took many photos at the holiday plan. Lily wrote about the day in the diary. As an only child, he learned to play alone.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the moon-lit yard by bike. Both of them like dumplings and milk. Lily wants to be a driver in the future.
